thread:
UC Berkeley has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus than USC, Arizona and Arizona State combined.

All 12 schools of the old Pac-12:

1. UC Berkeley: 277
2. USC: 94
3. Arizona: 84
4. Arizona State: 76
5. CU Boulder: 70
5. Washington: 70
7. Oregon: 57
8. Oregon State: 38
9. Stanford: 29
10. Utah: 16
11. UCLA: 14
12. Washington State: 8

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/rankings/

Mizzou has the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus of any big Missouri university. Saint Louis is 35 behind.

Every Missouri university with 10,000+ students:

1. Mizzou: 98
2. Saint Louis: 63
3. UMKC: 38
4. Central Missouri: 25
5. Missouri State: 23
6. UMSL: 6
7. WashU: 5

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/mo
